verdict.rationale: HelixDB ships an official CLI (documented at docs.helix-db.com/cli/getting-started) used for init/start/stop workflows and a 'helix chef' bootstrapper that installs AI query skills, scaffolds projects, and seeds data — clearly geared toward AI-native/agentic workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the CLI's AI-specific features and no detail on full command surface beyond quickstart/bootstrap.
